response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and a broad technical background, but his experience lacks depth in C++ for industrial automation and secure systems, which are critical for this role. His entrepreneurial and open-source contributions show initiative and versatility, but the role requires specialized expertise in high-performance, secure, and scalable C++ applications for industrial environments.
strengths: Extensive experience with full-stack development, including modern web technologies and cloud platforms (AWS, Kubernetes).
Proven track record in open-source projects and technical leadership, including mentoring and knowledge-sharing.
Strong problem-solving skills and adaptability across multiple programming languages and domains (embedded, web, mobile, desktop).
concerns: Limited recent hands-on experience with C++ for high-performance, multi-threaded, or industrial automation systems.
No explicit mention of Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) or industrial cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443).
Most recent roles focus on TypeScript, Node.js, and AI-agent infrastructure, diverging from the core C++ and industrial automation requirements.

key_factors.factor: Secure development and industrial cybersecurity exposure
